data.title: SELLAS Life Sciences Presents Preclinical Data Demonstrating SLS009 Activity in Pancreatic Cancer Models at the 2026 AACR Conference on Pancreatic Cancer
data.description: On September 25, 2026, SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: SLS) shared preclinical findings on SLS009 (tambiciclib), a CDK9 inhibitor, in patient-derived organoid models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). This data was unveiled at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Conference on Pancreatic Cancer in San Diego. The embargo on this information was lifted at 1:00 p.m. ET. SELLAS, a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company specializing in cancer therapies, showcased the results from studies during the conference held from September 25 to 28, 2026.

data.title: Bnode Announces Leadership Transition at Radial North America Ahead of Transition to Paxon North America
data.description: BRUSSELS--Bnode revealed today that Tom Schmitt, the CEO for Radial North America, will be leaving the company. Schmitt and the company have reached an agreement on this decision. Bnode expressed gratitude for Schmitt's contributions and wished him success in his future pursuits. In light of the upcoming transition to Paxon North America and the continuous transformation of the North American operations, new leadership has been appointed to steer the company's growth and operations moving forward. This change is effective immediately.

data.description: In the latest report, it was revealed that the unemployment rate has dropped to 4.5%, which is the lowest it has been in five years. This decrease represents a total of 300,000 fewer people unemployed compared to last quarter. Additionally, the economy has shown growth of 3.8% in the last year, with the stock market reaching record highs. The government has also announced an investment of $1.2 billion in infrastructure projects to further stimulate economic growth. Despite these positive indicators, there are concerns about inflation rising by 2.5% in the same period. Experts are optimistic about the future outlook but emphasize the need for continued monitoring of key economic indicators.

data.title: Proposal seeks shareholder approval for daily dividends for STRC and 3 other preferred stocks, following Bitcoin treasury firm Strive’s lead.
data.description: A new proposal for Strategy Corporation (STRC) suggests transitioning the company and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend disbursements, mirroring the recent decision by Bitcoin treasury company Strive.
